subject: New High School Schematic Design and Sustainability
overview: The committee reviewed and approved several design and sustainability specifications for the Medford Comprehensive High School project. Key decisions included the selection of all-electric heating for the pool, the refinement of healthy material standards, and the approval of the 'Bridge to the Fells' architectural concept and site circulation plans.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the October 6, 2026, committee meeting.

items.title: September and October Invoices
items.summary: Approved project invoices for September ($106,357) and October ($116,257) for OPM and architectural services.

items.title: Feasibility Study Budget Update
items.summary: Reviewed a high-level budget snapshot showing approximately $1.9 million spent to date against the $3 million feasibility study grant, with roughly $144,778 remaining in uncommitted funds.

items.title: Pool Heating System Selection
items.summary: Approved an all-electric air-to-water heat pump system for the pool based on a 50-year life-cycle cost analysis showing significant operational savings over gas-fired boilers.

items.title: Red List and Healthy Materials Resolution
items.summary: Approved a revised resolution to specify 'Red List Free' and healthy materials where economically feasible with at least three competitive equals to maximize indoor air quality and MSBA reimbursement.

items.title: Mass Timber Cost Alternates
items.summary: Approved the elimination of full-frame mass timber options and the addition of two targeted alternates for the gymnasium roof and the early childhood center for the next round of cost estimating.

items.title: Educational Planning and Floor Plan Update
items.summary: Reviewed updated floor plans and program adjacencies, highlighting the integration of CTE programs within academic learning communities and plans for a student locker usage survey.

items.title: Site Circulation and Safety Plans
items.summary: Evaluated updated site circulation designs featuring a new teardrop-shaped loop to accommodate bus and special education traffic while improving emergency vehicle access.

items.title: Site Identification Signage
items.summary: Approved a masonry school identification sign with external illumination for the Winthrop Street entrance in lieu of an LED message board.

items.title: Architectural Design and Exterior Materials
items.summary: Reviewed the 'Bridge to the Fells' architectural concept, which utilizes biophilic design elements, glassy entrances, and masonry cladding integrated with solar canopies.

items.title: Interior Finish Standards
items.summary: Discussed durable interior material selections, including linoleum and epoxy terrazzo flooring, wall tiles for high-traffic corridors, and acoustic ceiling baffles.

items.title: Informational Project Mailer
items.summary: Approved a $10,000–$14,000 project mailer to be sent to all Medford households to provide information on upcoming forums and the 2027 debt exclusion vote.
